inventory.name: Dozen Eggs
inventory.description: Bring the authentic taste of Grafton straight to your kitchen. Our full dozen includes beautiful, multi-colored eggs laid by our happy, free-ranging flock. We deliberately leave them unwashed to preserve their natural protective bloom, which keeps them incredibly fresh and allows for safe countertop storage. Because our flock includes roosters, these eggs are naturally fertilized—meaning they are just as perfect for your morning skillet as they are for an incubator if you want to hatch your own chicks!

inventory.name: Half Dozen Eggs
inventory.description: Perfectly portioned for smaller households or quick weekend trips, this half-dozen carton features the exact same premium, free-range eggs our community loves. Collected fresh daily, our eggs are kept strictly unwashed to maintain their natural bloom, locking in peak freshness and flavor the way nature intended. A simple, highly nutritious staple that stands out in any dish.

inventory.name: Nana Bea’s Peanut Butter Cookies (Gluten-Free)
inventory.description: Enjoy a comforting, homemade classic without the gluten! Nana Bea’s Peanut Butter Cookies are baked fresh right here on the farm. Each large, soft-baked cookie is packed with rich peanut butter flavor and made with our own farm-fresh eggs. It’s the perfect gluten-free treat to satisfy your sweet tooth while supporting local agriculture. (Contains: Peanuts, Egg, Dairy. Exempt from NH Licensing & Inspection)

inventory.name: Sammie’s Chocolate Chip Cookies
inventory.description: You can't beat a classic. Sammie's Chocolate Chip Cookies are baked from scratch with love, care, and our own farm-fresh eggs. Soft, chewy, and loaded with semi-sweet chocolate chips, these rustic cookies bring that nostalgic, straight-from-the-oven comfort right to your fingertips. Grab a bag for the ride home—they won't last long! (Contains: Wheat, Dairy, Egg, Soy, Corn)

inventory.name: Sammie’s Fudgy Farmstead Brownies
inventory.description: Indulge in pure, chocolatey perfection. Sammie’s Brownies are rich, dense, and baked to that ideal sweet spot using our own unwashed, free-range eggs. Handcrafted in small batches here at Flocking Reeds Farm, these decadent squares are the ultimate comfort dessert for any chocolate lover. (Contains: Wheat, Dairy, Egg)

inventory.name: The Peace Sign Feather Dream Catcher
inventory.description: Spread good vibes with this unique, handcrafted Peace Sign Dream Catcher. Meticulously shaped and woven using colorful, upcycled yarns from local thrift shops, this eco-conscious piece is accented with gorgeous, naturally molted feathers gathered by hand from our own flock. A beautiful, rustic statement piece that brings harmony and farmstead charm to any room.

inventory.name: The Rustic Sunflower Dream Catcher
inventory.description: Brighten up your space with a touch of sunshine! This handcrafted Sunflower Dream Catcher features a vibrant, warm-toned yarn web and a beautiful wooden sunflower centerpiece. Woven from sustainable, thrifted materials and finished with charming yarn tassels, this piece is a cheerful addition to a sunny window or a cozy corner of your home.

inventory.name: The Whimsical Snail Dream Catcher
inventory.description: Add a dash of whimsy to your walls with our handcrafted Snail Dream Catcher! Featuring a fun, hand-painted wooden snail resting comfortably in a web of brightly colored, upcycled yarn, this piece is perfect for a nursery, kids' room, or anyone who loves quirky, nature-inspired art. Hand-spun and uniquely yours from Sammie's Simple Living.

inventory.name: Feed the Flock & Homestead Tip Jar
inventory.description:
Welcome to the Flocking Reeds Farm tip jar! Because we operate as a no-kill homestead in Grafton, NH, all of our animals—from our pasture-raised laying hens and Coturnix quail to our geese and rabbits—live out their natural, happy lives right here with us.
100% of your donation goes directly toward the daily essentials that keep the chaos running smoothly: bags of grain and scratch, fresh pine shavings for winter bedding, coop maintenance supplies, and plenty of treats for the flock. Whether you're chipping in a couple of bucks for a flake of hay or helping us stock up on winter feed, thank you for supporting our homestead!

inventory.name: Dozen Farm Fresh Coturnix Quail Eggs
inventory.description: Small in size, huge on flavor! Laid fresh daily right here in Grafton, NH by our happy flock of Coturnix quail. Quail eggs have a higher yolk-to-white ratio than chicken eggs, giving them a rich, creamy texture that makes them a gourmet treat for frying, pickling, ramen, salads, or bite-sized deviled eggs. Packed with protein, vitamins, and B12! Grab a carton from the stand cooler and check out right here.
